pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' orientation. The dinosaur is bowing its head low, tilting the massive frill forward so it stands vertically in the frame.
pose_constraints.orientation: 0-degree head-on frontal view. The frill is the primary vertical element, filling the height of the frame.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: High-angle shot looking down at the face, which forces the frill to stand up tall behind the head. This minimizes horizontal spread.
pose_constraints.body_logic: The body and legs are completely tucked behind the head and frill. Total width is restricted to 320px by 'angling' the frill peaks upward.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The snout is at the bottom-center; the frill extends to the top-center. This creates a tall, oval-shaped silhouette perfect for a narrow crop.

character_details.expression: Noble and sturdy; eyes looking upward toward the camera from the bowed-head position.
character_details.texture: Clean, semi-matte 'studio-lighting' finish. Smooth surfaces with bold, graphic color sections.
character_details.colors: Deep charcoal-blue body. The frill is a bright parchment-white with two large, perfectly circular 'eye-spots' in vibrant sunset-orange.
features: Massive, elongated frill acting as a vertical backdrop.
Brow horns pointing directly at the camera/viewer, foreshortened to save width.
Simplified, powerful beak at the bottom of the pillar.

environmental_details.ground: Simple, clean river sand with a few high-contrast green ferns at the very base.
flora: Tall, thin prehistoric trees in the far background to emphasize the vertical composition.
environmental_details.lighting: Strong top-down 'Stage' lighting that hits the top edge of the frill and the tips of the horns.
environmental_details.sky: Deep, solid cyan sky to make the white and orange frill 'pop'.
